custom_checks.name: unmapped_pe_names_retain_raw_value
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(candidate._creative_name IS DISTINCT FROM candidate._creative_name_raw) AS value FROM {table} AS candidate WHERE LOWER(TRIM(candidate._advertiser)) = 'purely elizabeth' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.creative_mapping` AS mapping WHERE LOWER(TRIM(mapping.advertiser)) = LOWER(TRIM(candidate._advertiser)) AND ((mapping.match_scope = 'tactic_creative' AND LOWER(TRIM(mapping.initiative)) = LOWER(TRIM(candidate.initiative)) AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(mapping.source_creative_name)), '') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(candidate._creative_name_raw)), '')) OR (mapping.match_scope = 'creative' AND NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(mapping.source_creative_name)), '') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(candidate._creative_name_raw)), ''))))
